card.name: Small words in old encyclopedia prose
card.fires_on: Short function words or adjectives (a, the, on, by, first, soft, white) inside descriptive sentences in old encyclopedia or dictionary-style text, just before a noun is named.

modes.label: Articles before a noun
modes.description: The word a or the sits right before a described object or term.
modes.example: A gallows, which consists of two uprights and<< a>> beam resting on them.

modes.label: Adjectives before a noun
modes.description: A descriptive adjective comes just before the thing it describes.
modes.example: A<< soft>> packing is a blanket of wool or rubber
